concepts.title: Matter, States and the Nature of Matter
concepts.definition: Chemistry studies the composition, structure, properties and changes of matter, which exists in solid, liquid and gaseous states and shows physical and chemical properties, with the three states interconvertible by changing temperature and pressure.
concepts.key_idea: The solid state has ordered particles, liquids have mobility with contacts, and gases fill the whole space, so state changes are physical transformations without altering composition.

concepts.title: Mole Concept and Molar Mass Computation
concepts.definition: One mole of a substance contains 6.022 x 10^23 particles, and its mass in grams equals the molar mass, so the number of moles is the given mass divided by the molar mass of the substance.
concepts.key_idea: Avogadro's number 6.022 x 10^23 links the microscopic count of particles to the macroscopic mass measured on a balance.
concepts.textbook_ref: kech101.txt mole concept and molar mass section

solution_steps.explain: Divide the given mass of the substance by its molar mass to get the number of moles

concepts.title: Mass Percent, Empirical and Molecular Formula
concepts.definition: The mass percent of an element in a compound is the mass of that element in one mole of the compound divided by the molar mass and multiplied by 100, and empirical formula gives the simplest whole number ratio of atoms while molecular formula is a multiple of the empirical formula.
concepts.key_idea: Molecular formula = n times empirical formula, where n is found by dividing the molar mass by the empirical formula mass.

solution_steps.explain: Divide the mass of the element by the molar mass of the compound and multiply by 100

concepts.title: Stoichiometry, Limiting Reagent and Concentration Terms
concepts.definition: Balanced equations give stoichiometric relationships among reactants and products; the limiting reagent decides the maximum product, and solution concentration is expressed in molarity, molality, mole fraction and mass percent.
concepts.key_idea: Molarity is moles of solute per litre of solution, while molality is moles of solute per kilogram of solvent and is temperature independent.
